cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll supervise rebuilding those wedding bookings. You may start reassuring the couples.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials. Should I tell them that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. You're authorized to give replacement dates. I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Bulk restore emails them the canceller's name. Reentering as new bookings doesn't, but it takes all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve the afternoon. I'll read you each date as you enter it. Tell the couples I'm personally giving up my afternoon to put this right.

reason: Rereading requires explicit no-attribution effect for the alternate method; avoid implying couples remain on the telephone for the entire afternoon.
